scope.bulk_artifacts: Reviewed through evidence/source integrity rather than feeding telemetry/images into blind source diff

findings.title: Make initial recovery binding recoverable after ledger-publication failure
findings.detail: initialize commits the recovery-state binding before publishing ledger.json. Injecting OSError from _save leaves one committed binding and no ledger; normal startup, initialize retry, status and resume cannot recover through supported tooling.
findings.recommendation: Journal initialization intent before the database binding, then support bounded idempotent recovery of that same intent; do not silently reset a genuinely lost deployed ledger.

resolution.implementation: Durable initialization intent precedes binding; exact-intent resume is idempotent and missing deployed ledgers remain denied.
resolution.verification: Real subprocess exits at initialization boundaries; inode/schema/generation/layout mismatch regressions; final-image CLI fault/resume checks.

findings.title: Reject the reserved database root role before binding or restore reservation
findings.detail: The role validator accepts database alongside artifacts/custody. In _stage, the expanded root maps overwrite the reserved database source/target entry. Initialization and backup succeed; restore reserves a new generation then fails, and resume repeats the invalid mapping.
findings.recommendation: Reject reserved role names at layout validation or keep the database mapping structurally separate from caller-supplied root roles.

resolution.implementation: Reserved database root role rejected during layout validation before effects.
resolution.verification: Fresh initialization and existing-ledger restore regressions; no binding/reservation.

findings.title: Validate the complete generated backup against restore limits before publication
findings.detail: Creation counts content before adding manifest.json and measures depth from each source root; restore walks the entire package including manifest and its role prefix. A successful package at MAX_FILES or the accepted source depth can therefore be rejected by restore.

proof.depth_case: 32 actual nested directories; backup files35; restore denied

findings.recommendation: Apply a single package-aware budget including manifest bytes/count/depth and MAX_METADATA; run package verification on staging before exclusive publication.

resolution.implementation: Complete staged backup verified against restore limits before exclusive publication.
resolution.verification: Actual4096-entry successful restore; actual32-level depth rejection; metadata/manifest-byte boundaries.

findings.title: Preserve committed retention tombstones when restoring an older snapshot
findings.detail: _preserve_external_history excludes retention tombstones/removal audits, and nonexternal terminal runs bypass the run preservation check. A backup before purge restores the payload and removes the tombstone/removal audit from active history. Old private database copies remain, so this is not a claim that every historical copy is destroyed.
findings.recommendation: Refuse snapshots missing current protected deletion receipts, or carry forward validated tombstones and keep their payloads removed before publication. Preserve associated active deletion audit history.

resolution.implementation: Restore requires current tombstones/removal audits and removed marker/digest identity before reserving generation.
resolution.verification: Real Alembic042 and HTTP purge; old snapshot refusal; current snapshot restore; changed receipt/audit/identity denial; unknown external-work preservation.

findings.title: Clean up or durably track failed upgrade-copy staging databases
findings.detail: Copy/migration/validation/publication failures have no enclosing cleanup or resumable upgrade mapping. Three injected Alembic failures left three full .upgrade-* copies while source stayed unchanged and output absent; every retry allocates another copy.

proof.fixture: tiny private SQLite input carrying schema028 marker; failure injected before migration

findings.recommendation: Remove only positively owned unpublished staging files on ordinary failure, or retain one durable resumable attempt with explicit bounded cleanup; add interrupted upgrade-copy regressions.

resolution.implementation: Ordinary failed upgrade cleans only owned unpublished staging and private sidecars, retaining foreign/published outputs.
resolution.verification: Repeated migration failure followed by real successful retry; partial copy/schema/publication/BaseException cases; independent foreign-inode probe.

findings.title: Preserve or explicitly warn before discarding same-scope settings drafts
findings.detail: The form key includes policy version/authorization epoch, so a background refetch seeing an external update remounts it and silently resets values/reason. The query is immediately stale and the installed QueryClient retains focus-refetch defaults. A transient refetch error also removes the existing form through !policy.isError.

proof.verification: source path + installed TanStack Query defaults; no fresh browser reproduction

findings.recommendation: Keep scope/session remount isolation, but retain dirty same-scope drafts or request an explicit reload acknowledgement when fresh policy data differs.

resolution.implementation: Same-scope drafts retain immutable base version/reason; changed server policy pauses save; explicit fresh reads replace drafts; definite GET/PATCH401/403 clears and latches closed.
resolution.verification: 20 focused cases;512 frontend tests;3 real composed journeys including native Chromium visibility refetch, guarded503, actual CSRF403, successful CAS save and scope/session reset.

findings.title: Update the operator upgrade runbook to the verified schema042 result
findings.detail: The final runbook states destination schema041 while the linked final upgrade-results.json and current migration head are042.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the runbook statement with the linked final evidence and current supported upgrade target.

resolution.implementation: Runbook destination corrected to schema042 and drift tested against linked upgrade evidence.
resolution.verification: Original041 statement failed new regression;60 documentation tests passed.

dismissed.title: Restored password/account policy
dismissed.reason: The approved restore design explicitly preserves account/password/membership state; canonical invalidation enumerates sessions/machine/task credentials and epochs. A stronger forced-password-recovery policy is not established as this implementation contract. No new authorization-revival claim is made.

dismissed.title: Restore event chain only in active database
dismissed.reason: Private old database roots retain pre-restore events; permanent audit loss was not demonstrated. Unlike the explicit one-way retention invariant, an active merged restore-event chain is not unambiguously required by the current bounded contract.

dismissed.title: Old restore copies are retained
dismissed.reason: Retention of private old roots and operator disk budgeting are explicit runbook/rollback limits, not silent unintended deletion or lock release.

dismissed.title: Incomplete backup directories are retained
dismissed.reason: Private incomplete backup retention is documented and never accepted as complete. This does not dismiss the independently verified untracked upgrade-copy leak.

dismissed.title: Aggregate copy cost before rejection
dismissed.reason: Per-root bytes/entries and role count are bounded. Upfront aggregate budgeting remains a design improvement; no separate unbounded-input or state-corruption defect established beyond the accepted package-limit finding.

dismissed.title: Purge lacks an additional human check
dismissed.reason: support.scope enters guard_project; trusted_capability_allowed grants nonhuman service-request principals only automation.read/request, so automation.admin is already human-audience-only.
